purpose: Reproduce the D-L2 agent's WAF finding independently, through the production scorer (TypeSafeToolRiskScorer), single rubric tool_risk.
reading: The block is on the string, not the intent: a harmless note that merely mentions the path is blocked, a real exfiltration of a different file is scored. Any text an attacker can place into a tool input can make Jev unavailable for that call. The ledger's jev_unavailable reason is only the exception type, which a bad key also produces.
